There are so many posts linking to articles in this sub that are pro-reddit and anti-voat. Spreading this information is pretty much the point of this sub, but by directly linking to these websites not only increases their search ranking, it generates traffic and ad revenue for them. Isn't that the exact opposite of what we want to do?

Solution

Use sites such as archive.is to archive sites, and/or screenshot the article and upload it to something like veuwer.

Not only does this stop generating traffic, it also archives the site, so in the off chance that there is outrage over misinformation, we can point to the archive and say "look, we have proof that it happened."

I understand that archive.is is often blocked in workplaces, so having both an archive and screenshots would be very much beneficial.
